Kind.description: Kind of run. Listing tools use it as a hint.

ModelType.description: Kind of model that wrote the data.

ColumnDtype.description: Element type of a table column.

UnitSystem.description: COMPONENT_BASE means per unit, on the base named by base_reference. NATURAL_UNITS means physical units, given in units; it has no base_reference.

BaseReference.description: Base of a COMPONENT_BASE value. The value system is the system base power. The value component is the own base of the component.

RunStatus.description: Status of a run. RUNNING means a writer is open. The other two values name the end state.

QuantityKind.description: Kind of a physical quantity. The list is a copy of the quantity kinds in SiennaSchemas Core/units.json.

Duration.description: ISO 8601 duration that uses days, hours, minutes, and seconds.

Filter.description: HDF5 filter: shuffle, or deflate with a level from 1 to 9.

TypeName.description: Name of a Julia type. It starts with an upper case letter.

Meta.description: Entry label. It has no double underscore and no slash, because the HDF5 path uses both as separators.

Timestamp.description: Naive local datetime with no zone or offset.

PathName.description: One path segment. It is not empty, not . or .., and has no slash or backslash.

AxisGroup.description: HDF5 group path that holds the axis data.
